services.name: Taekwondo Masters
services.desc: Tae Kwon Do, Karate, Kung Fu, and Judo are all forms of martial arts. All of these forms have the same goals: to build character, self-defense skills, and self-confidence. Tae Kwon Do is a Korean martial art form that has undergone autonomous development for more than 2000 years. The words Tae Kwon Do literally mean the “art of kicking and punching” (Tae=foot, Kwon=fist, Do=art or way). To build true confidence, through knowledge in the mind,honesty in the heart, and strength in the body.To keep friendship with one anotherand to build a strong and happy community.Never fight to achieve selfish endsbut to develop might for right.
